question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Negligent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Careful**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Negligent **means showing a lack of attention or care.

 
 
• Example - *He was **negligent **in not reporting the accident to the police.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Careful means giving a lot of attention to details to be sure something is right.
 
 
• Example - *I’ll need to give this matter some **careful **thought.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Negligent**' and 'Careful' are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Composed **means free from agitation or excitement.
 
• **Calm **means not excited, worried or angry; quiet.
 
• **Careless **means not taking or showing enough care and attention.
